catalog.title: Summary
catalog.doc: One sentence on what is happening now, and what to look at.
catalog.help: The one-sentence answer to “is anything wrong?” for the deploys in the chosen time range. The bar has one segment per deploy, worst first, and the counts under it add up to the same number as the sentence. Colour only ever means state: regressed, acted on, being judged, healthy.

options.name: bar
options.label: Show the bar
options.doc: One segment per deploy, worst first.

options.name: counts
options.label: Show the counts
options.doc: How many deploys are in each state, under the bar.

catalog.title: Radar state
catalog.doc: Whether the radar is watching, which source it reads and how fresh that is.
catalog.help: Whether the radar itself can be trusted right now: how fresh its data is, whether it may act or only watch, whether the circuit breaker is open, whether the Postgres log is flowing, and which namespaces it covers. If something here is off, read the panels below with care.

catalog.title: Deploys
catalog.doc: The deploys in the window, newest first; the one you pick drives the panels that follow a deploy.
catalog.help: Every deploy the radar tracked in the chosen time range, with the state the radar reached and one sentence on why. Click one to make the panels that follow a deploy show it.

catalog.title: Deploy
catalog.doc: The picked deploy: its grade, what the radar decided and since when.
catalog.help: The deploy you picked: what it is, whether the radar judged it a regression, what it did about it, and when it will look again. “Open as a case” shows the same deploy full width.

catalog.title: Canary vs control
catalog.doc: The picked deploy's measurement over time, canary against control, with the deploy marked.
catalog.help: How long the chosen query took over time on the canary pods (red) against the stable pods (blue), with the deploy marked. If the red line leaves the blue one at the marker, the deploy is what changed. Where there are no stable pods to compare, the chart shows the query's own history and its level before the deploy.

options.name: unit
options.label: Query to open on
options.doc: Which query to chart first: the one that most explains the verdict (the engine's own order, and the ones it keeps a series for), or the flagged query that moved furthest from 1.0, which may have no series.
labels: The one that explains the verdict
The one that moved the most

options.name: baseline
options.label: Show the level before the deploy
options.doc: A dashed line at the average before the deploy.

options.name: samples
options.label: Show how many calls each point rests on
options.doc: The small bars under the chart: thin evidence has short bars.

options.name: zero
options.label: Start the axis at zero
options.doc: Off fits the axis to the data, which makes small changes look larger.

catalog.title: Figures
catalog.doc: The picked deploy in numbers: ratio, interval, evidence and how many units moved.
catalog.help: The picked deploy in a few numbers: the evidence grade (A to D), how much database time the deploy added, how much of the slowdown is attributed to the deploy, how many queries regressed out of how many were tested, and how much of the load those queries cover.

options.name: grade
options.label: Show the evidence grade
options.doc: How much weight the evidence can bear, from A to D.

options.name: impact
options.label: Show the added database time
options.doc: How much database time the deploy added.

options.name: attribution
options.label: Show the share attributed to the deploy
options.doc: How much of the slowdown is put down to the deploy.

options.name: regressed
options.label: Show the queries regressed
options.doc: How many queries regressed out of how many were tested.

options.name: coverage
options.label: Show the coverage
options.doc: How much of the load the tested queries cover.

catalog.title: Why this grade
catalog.doc: The reasoning behind the grade, in plain words, and what would change it.
catalog.help: The radar's reasoning for the grade, in plain words: what kind of comparison it could make, what the strongest evidence was, and what limited the grade.

catalog.title: Evidence
catalog.doc: Per query: how it moved, with the interval around it.
catalog.help: Each query the radar tested for the picked deploy: how much slower it got (the 95% interval is on hover), its share of the database's time, any flags that limited the grade, and how many observations stand behind it. Click a query to chart it.

options.name: flags
options.label: Show the flags
options.doc: What limited the grade of each query.

options.name: counts
options.label: Show the observations before and after
options.doc: How many observations stand behind each query.

catalog.title: Ratio per query
catalog.doc: Every query's ratio with its interval on one axis, and a line at 1.0 where nothing changed.
catalog.help: Every tested query on one axis: the dot is how many times slower (or faster) it got and the bar is the 95% interval. A bar that stays clear of the line at 1.0 means the query really moved. Click one to chart it.

catalog.title: Evaluations
catalog.doc: The evaluations the radar made of the picked deploy, in order; pick two to compare.
catalog.help: Each time the radar judged the picked deploy, in order. Pick two to see what changed between them. An older judgement keeps only the queries that were flagged then.

catalog.title: Ledger
catalog.doc: What the radar did about the picked deploy, step by step, with the time of each.
catalog.help: What the radar did about the picked deploy, step by step and with the time of each: the action it wanted, what it did, and whether it checked that it worked.

catalog.title: Activity
catalog.doc: Decisions and actions across all deploys as they happen.
catalog.help: Decisions and actions across every deploy, newest first, updating as they happen. Red marks a regression; the deploy names open that deploy.

catalog.title: Safety
catalog.doc: What the radar may do here: whether it can abort, and which namespaces it may act in.
catalog.help: What the radar is allowed to do for each watch: its mode (shadow only watches, enforce may act), whether acting is switched on, whether the circuit breaker has stopped it, and which namespaces it may act in.

catalog.title: Source health
catalog.doc: Whether each source the radar reads is answering, how recent its last data is, and what is missing.
catalog.help: Whether each source the radar reads is answering, per watch: query statistics and the Postgres log, how recent the newest data is, and what it means for the verdicts if one is missing.

queryFields.name: app
queryFields.doc: The application a deploy belongs to, such as checkout.

queryFields.name: namespace
queryFields.doc: The Kubernetes namespace of the deploy.

queryFields.name: state
queryFields.doc: Where the radar got to with a deploy.

queryFields.name: grade
queryFields.doc: The evidence grade of a deploy's verdict.

queryFields.name: deploy
queryFields.doc: One deploy, by its id. Without it the panel follows the deploy picked on the board.

queryFields.name: query
queryFields.doc: A database query, as the panels name it, such as "SELECT on orders".

queryFields.name: statement
queryFields.doc: The kind of statement: SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE or DELETE.
